## Welcome to My Portfolio

Hello! I am an applied mathematician and researcher specializing in **scientific computing, numerical analysis, and machine learning**. My work focuses on bridging rigorous mathematical modeling with high-performance software architecture to solve complex multiphysics and data-driven problems.

I hold a Ph.D. in Applied Mathematics from Université Laval and have extensive experience developing robust simulation environments, numerical solvers, and machine learning pipelines.
:::

---

## Featured Projects

Here is a glimpse of the projects and tools featured in this portfolio:

*   **[Deep Learning & AI](./ai-ml/index.qmd):** 
    *   **OptiTherm (Digital Twin):** A data-driven Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework built with PyTorch for optimizing building energy efficiency using the BDG2 dataset.
    *   **Custom ML Engine:** Neural network architectures and classification frameworks built from scratch using NumPy and PyTorch.

*   **[Scientific Computing & C++](./scientific-computing/index.qmd):**
    *   **CFEM++:** A high-performance C++ scientific computing library for multiphysics simulations and Cut Finite Element Methods (CutFEM).
    *   **PyOdys:** An open-source Python package designed for solving ordinary differential equations using advanced Runge-Kutta and multistep integration schemes.

---

## Background & Expertise

*   **Mathematical Modeling:** Partial Differential Equations (PDEs), Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs), Finite Element Methods (FEM/CutFEM), and Numerical Optimization.
*   **Programming & Technologies:** Python (`PyTorch`, `NumPy`, `SciPy`), C/C++ (`PETSc`, `Eigen`), `Git`, and `Linux`.
*   **Academic & R&D Experience:** Postdoctoral research at GIREF (Université Laval) and teaching roles within the college network.
